description: This file defines data pipe classes for data transformation and collation in PyTorch data loading pipeline, including MapperIterDataPipe and CollatorIterDataPipe, with associated helper functions.

classes.name: MapperIterDataPipe
classes.description: A data pipe that applies a function to each item from a source data pipe, supporting input and output column specifications.

classes.name: CollatorIterDataPipe
classes.description: A data pipe that collates data samples into tensors using a specified or default collate function.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the data pipe with a source data pipe and a function or collate configuration.

methods.name: _apply_fn
methods.description: Applies the stored function to a data item, handling different input/output column configurations.

methods.name: __iter__
methods.description: Iterates over the source data pipe, applying the function to each item.

methods.name: __len__
methods.description: Returns the length of the data pipe if the source data pipe has a length.
